title: Singapore office and government MOU | Anthropic
author: Anthropic
description: Anthropic opens its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signs an MOU with the government on AI safety, evaluation, and responsible adoption.
summary: Singapore is one of our most active markets anywhere in the world, and Claude is already powering Singaporean business and government services used by millions of people every day, like GovTech Singapore, Grab, and DBS. Our growing local team will ensure these organizations and many more stay on the frontier with safe, capable AI.
takeaways: “Singapore has been a leader in responsible AI, with a long track record of investment in model testing and evaluation,” said Mann.
Under the MOU, we plan to hold technical exchanges with Singapore’s AI safety, security, and assurance institutions on model evaluation, testing standards, and incident response.

In financial services, DBS, Southeast Asia’s largest bank, works with Claude across a range of use cases in its Singapore operations—including software development and day-to-day productivity—as part of its broader AI innovation efforts.
